data.heading: Week 1 (31 Oct -06 Nov 2025):
data.text: - Minimum Temperature is likely to be above normal in NE India, East India, Central India, Gujarat and many parts of NW India.

data.heading: Week 2 (07 Nov -13 Nov 2025):
data.text: - Minimum Temperature is likely to be above normal in NE India, J&K and Uttarakhand and it is likely to be below normal in the rest of India.
